Use `information-architecture`, `frontend-design` and `video-editor-ux` as applicable.

Produce screen-level low-fidelity specifications for Overview, Video Library, Import, Processing Monitor, Candidate Discovery, Clip Studio, Brand Kit, Publishing Calendar, Social Accounts, Analytics, AI Settings and Workspace/Automation Policies.

For every screen specify goal, primary user, hierarchy, layout zones, primary/secondary actions, relevant states, navigation and responsive collapse. The Clip Studio spec must give preview/timeline sufficient prominence and document left context/right inspector behavior.

No frontend code or high-fidelity CSS. Update `docs/design/05-SCREEN-SPECIFICATIONS.md` only if authorized. Request `APPROVE WIREFRAMES v1`.
